system.name: FAB (Finetuning-activated Adversarial Behaviors)
system.one_liner: An attack that uses meta-learning to plant a behaviour that stays dormant in a shared LLM and appears once a user finetunes the model.

content.variant_note: three actor columns (adversary, model-sharing platform, user) along which one cartoon model is passed through circled steps 1 to 5 and recoloured at each step
content.argues: A model that looks benign and passes safety checks can be compromised so that the adversarial behaviour only appears after a user finetunes it.
content.subject: The threat model of FAB: planting the behaviour by meta-learning, uploading to a platform, safety evaluation, user finetuning and a deployed answer that advertises.

lessons.what_to_learn: Follow one character through numbered steps across actor columns and recolour it at each step (blue benign, red adversarial), so state changes need no text; hang a red-outlined detail box with a V pointer on the first arrow to open its inner algorithm.

evidence: the adversary plants the adversarial behavior into a base model via our meta-learning algorithm
The resulting model can be openly shared on popular platforms
the dormant adversarial behavior is activated when the model is finetuned by an unsuspecting user

summary: FAB is an attack in which an adversary uses meta-learning to plant a behaviour that stays dormant in a shared LLM and appears after a user finetunes it. Figure 1 draws the threat model as three actor columns, Adversary, Model Sharing Pipeline and User, along which a cartoon robot passes through five circled steps. A red-outlined box with a V-shaped callout opens step 1: a chain of checkpoints from theta_0 to theta_T, each with a simulated-finetuning copy that turns from blue to red. The model is uploaded to Hugging Face and passes a safety table of green ticks; the user then finetunes it on a chosen dataset (Math, Health or Code), and the red robot answers with advertising text highlighted in red.
summary_zh: FAB 攻击在共享的大模型里用元学习埋下休眠行为，用户微调后才触发。图按攻击者、模型分享流水线、用户三列，让同一机器人角色经 ①–⑤ 步，从蓝变红：红框展开元学习与模拟微调，经安全评测对勾后，用户选数据集微调，回答里出现红色广告词。
notes: Text was converted to outlines in the SVG (0 text items), so all labels were read from the picture and the font size is unknown. Prior kinds and variant kept (actor-interaction first); the figure also reads as a pipeline of one artifact with numbered steps. The three columns are one drawing with lanes because arrows and the red callout cross them. The grey-robot row with dash, cross, dash in the safety table is not explained by the caption.
